passage.text: Thank you for applying for the graduate trainee position at our company.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər əˈplaɪɪŋ fər ðə ˈɡrædʒuət ˌtreɪˈniː pəˈzɪʃən ət aʊr ˈkʌmpəni.

passage.text: We are happy to tell you that you have been selected for an interview.
passage.reading: wiː ər ˈhæpi tə ˈtɛl juː ðæt juː hæv bɪn sɪˈlɛktɪd fər ən ˈɪntərvjuː.

passage.text: We received more than two hundred applications, and only twenty candidates were selected.
passage.reading: wiː rɪˈsiːvd ˈmɔːr ðən ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃənz, ənd ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛnti ˈkændɪdəts wɜːr sɪˈlɛktɪd.

passage.text: Your interview will be next Monday at 10 a.m. at our head office.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈɪntərvjuː wɪl bi ˈnɛkst ˈmʌndeɪ ət ˈtɛn ˌeɪˈɛm ət aʊr ˈhɛd ˈɔːfɪs.

passage.text: You will meet a panel of three interviewers: the head of human resources, the head of marketing and one of this year's trainees.
passage.reading: juː wɪl ˈmiːt ə ˈpænəl əv ˈθriː ˈɪntərvjuːərz: ðə ˈhɛd əv ˈhjuːmən ˈriːsɔːrsɪz, ðə ˈhɛd əv ˈmɑːrkɪtɪŋ ənd ˈwʌn əv ðɪs ˈjɪrz ˌtreɪˈniːz.

passage.text: The interview will take about forty-five minutes.
passage.reading: ði ˈɪntərvjuː wɪl ˈteɪk əˈbaʊt ˈfɔːrti ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts.

passage.text: After that, you will take a short writing test in English.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈðæt, juː wɪl ˈteɪk ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈraɪtɪŋ ˈtɛst ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

passage.text: Please bring two copies of your résumé and a copy of your ID card.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ ˈtuː ˈkɑːpiz əv jʊr ˈrɛzəmeɪ ənd ə ˈkɑːpi əv jʊr ˌaɪˈdiː ˈkɑːrd.

passage.text: If you have any certificates, please bring copies of those, too.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni sərˈtɪfɪkəts, ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ ˈkɑːpiz əv ˈðoʊz, ˈtuː.

passage.text: When you arrive, please go to the reception desk on the fifth floor.
passage.reading: wɛn juː əˈraɪv, ˈpliːz ˈɡoʊ tə ðə rɪˈsɛpʃən ˈdɛsk ɑːn ðə ˈfɪfθ ˈflɔːr.

passage.text: Please reply to this email by Friday to confirm that you can attend.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz rɪˈplaɪ tə ðɪs ˈiːmeɪl baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ tə kənˈfɜːrm ðæt juː kən əˈtɛnd.

passage.text: If you have any questions, please call me at our office.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz, ˈpliːz ˈkɔːl miː ət aʊr ˈɔːfɪs.

passage.text: We look forward to meeting you.
passage.reading: wiː ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈmiːtɪŋ juː.
